safe_test_strategy: Compare the same protected object under its owner and a distinct non-owner identity.
expected_behavior: Non-owner must not receive protected owner data.

potential_false_positives.scenario: Public, cached, reflected or synthetic content resembles a protected result.
potential_false_positives.mitigation: Verify the resource policy, distinct identities, provenance and negative controls before confirming.

confirmation_criteria: Distinct authenticated identities, verified ownership, protected fields and repeated unauthorized disclosure.
